_comment: Kestrel Art Supply 'Swipe Your Color' stop-motion hand-swatch-cycle — THE WORKED EXAMPLE. Copy to config.json and edit. A ~16.6s vertical 9:16 stop-motion where a medium-tan hand swipes a Softline oil-pastel stick across a round off-white paper card on a saturated mustard-yellow background, cycling through the color family (~10 colors), exiting frame to reveal all 10 swatches, then returning on the hero pick (color 3), closing on a Kestrel end card. NO voiceover — a pre-sourced music track carries it. Pipeline: (1) ONE gpt-image-2 master-anchor plate (hand + stick + EMPTY paper card on yellow BG); (2) each color plate in gpt-image-2 EDIT mode anchored to [master-anchor, color-swatch, color-hero] — NEVER chained; (3) motion / half-painted transition plates + finale plates (hand-exits -> all-swatches -> hero-pick); (4) PNG->mp4 loop-encode at each plate's hold, concat-demux -> silent master; (5) Playwright HTML end card + brand music mux. Master 1080x1920 h264+aac, ~16.6s (13.6s body + 3.0s end card). See scripts/PIPELINE.md for the scripts. Creative fields -- background.hand, background.bg_hex/bg_desc, background.skin_patch (the test surface), anchor.prompt, the hero-pick plate and music.prompt/track -- come from the recipe's choices (hand, background, surface, hero variant, music); never copy them as defaults. Copy the structure and field names only.
title: Find your Softline color

background._comment: Format constants held VERBATIM in EVERY plate prompt so the frame never moves — only the stick color + the painted swatch stripe change per plate.
background.hand: single medium-tan hand (fingers + thumb, palm down, short unpainted nails) entering from the bottom edge in the LOWER-LEFT third, holding a Softline oil-pastel stick by its mid-section (chunky round stick in a kraft-paper sleeve, small printed 'kestrel' wordmark crisp, tip worn to a soft bevel)
background.skin_patch: a round off-white textured paper card (~400px wide) in the UPPER-RIGHT third — the surface swatches are tested on, flat, cold-press texture, soft-shadowed, no markings
background.lighting: editorial soft daylight, gentle matte highlights, top-down macro, 9:16 vertical, photorealistic product editorial, no text overlay
background.camera: top-down editorial macro, LOCKED — no camera move, no zoom, no pan

anchor._comment: The MASTER-ANCHOR plate. EVERY other plate is generated in gpt-image-2 EDIT mode anchored back to THIS plate (plus per-color swatch + hero refs) — NEVER chained plate-to-plate.
anchor.prompt: Top-down editorial macro on a saturated mustard-yellow (#E8C547) seamless paper background. In the LOWER-LEFT third, a single medium-tan hand enters from the bottom holding a Softline oil-pastel stick by its mid-section (chunky round stick in a kraft-paper sleeve, small printed 'kestrel' wordmark crisp, beveled tip toward upper-right). In the UPPER-RIGHT third, a round off-white textured paper card (~400px wide, flat, cold-press texture, soft-shadowed, no markings) — the surface swatches are tested on. Editorial soft daylight, gentle matte highlights. 9:16 vertical. Photorealistic product editorial. No text overlay.

plate_engine._comment: All plates + the end-card BG are gpt-image-2 via fal. EDIT mode: each color / motion / finale plate passes the master-anchor (`v2-p01-hand-anchor.png`) as the first EDIT anchor so the hand + crop + BG stay frozen; color plates ALSO pass that variant's real swatch + hero refs. NEVER pass a prior plate as the anchor.

cadence._comment: Demo holds: half-painted / mid-swipe motion plates ~180ms; per-color plates ~380ms (some stretched to ~1000ms for a slower, more scannable cycle); the anchor + finale hero beats 1100-1800ms. HARD cuts between plates. Average ~380ms hold. 27 plate clips across the run.

plates.prompt: MASTER-ANCHOR — hand holding the stick in the lower-left, EMPTY paper card in the upper-right, on the mustard-yellow BG. See config.anchor.prompt.
Same locked frame. The hand extends slightly toward the paper card, the stick tip hovering ~30mm above the card (about to swipe). No swatch yet. Preview gesture.

Same locked frame. NEW: a thick waxy swatch stripe in COLOR 1 (pale butter yellow) swiped horizontally across the center of the paper card. The hand now holds the COLOR 1 stick. Only the color changed.
Same locked frame, captured MID-SWIPE — the stick tip touches the card, the color 2 fresh swatch about half-painted, slight diagonal hand motion. Transition plate.
Same locked frame. The swatch on the card is REPLACED with COLOR 2 (warm apricot); the hand holds the COLOR 2 stick. Same crop, same light — only the color changed.

Repeat one {color plate + half-painted-transition} pair per color in the family (the demo ran 10 colors: 01-10 → ~24 cycle plates). Same locked frame throughout, each color EDIT-anchored to the master-anchor + its own swatch + hero.
Same locked frame, but the HAND EXITS the frame, revealing ALL 10 swatch stripes stacked on the paper card. Grounded on the all-colors family reference.
The full 10-swatch family on the card, no hand — the 'here's everything' reveal beat. Holds so the viewer scans for their favorite.
The hand RETURNS holding the HERO pick (COLOR 3), the other 9 swatches still visible underneath. The payoff — 'this one is yours'. Hero hold.

end_card._comment: A Kestrel end card: a gpt-image-2 hero BG (endcard-bgs/color-hero.png) + a Playwright render of end-card-template-v3.html (serif tagline + sans subtitle + the Kestrel logo SVG) — NEVER AI-rendered text. Holds 3.0s WITH the music still playing under it, fade at the tail (no silent tail).
end_card.subtitle: Softline Pastels · kestrelart.example

music._comment: Pre-sourced brand track (brand-track.mp3, ~128 BPM instrumental). Volume 0.4, fade in/out. NO VO. `source` = generate would call create-music-elevenlabs music_v1 from `prompt` (no artist names — ElevenLabs ToS filter).
music.prompt: Upbeat, bright, playful instrumental pop, ~128 BPM, light percussion, clean modern art-studio energy. No vocals.

audio_mix._comment: The music is the full bed — no VO to duck under. It plays UNDER the end card and fades over the tail, so the video ends WITH the music — no trailing silence.

music.note: the pre-sourced brand-track track IS the bed (no VO), volume 0.4, fade in/out

captions.note: the swatch cycle reads visually; on-screen type is only the end-card tagline/subtitle

end_card.note: hero-BG + HTML-template card (serif 'Swipe your color.' + sans subtitle + Kestrel logo SVG), music under it, fade tail (no silent tail)
